item.title: Teacher, Admin Contracts Approved; Principal Pay Debated
item.description: It’s official: over the next three years, teachers will get a 13.57 percent average raise and unionized school administrators will get a 9.6 percent average raise. The Board of Alders made that commitment while issuing a final approval for two NHPS contracts Wednesday, with lingering questions about the actual costs of the admin union contract. The post Teacher, Admin Contracts Approved; Principal Pay Debated appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: A Van Crash, & A Power Outage
item.description: More than 1,100 East Rockers lost power at around 8:30 p.m. Wednesday after a U-Haul van crashed into a utility pole on Orange Street between Trumbull and Bradley. A United Illuminating (UI) spokesperson said that all of the customers impacted by this outage had their power restored by 4 a.m. Thursday. The post A Van Crash, & A Power Outage appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Displaced Fairmont Tenants Wait & Wait & Wait For Elevator Fix
item.description: Faith Martin has spent the last four weeks and five days in a fourth-floor hotel room, waiting for the city's public housing authority to repair a broken elevator in the Annex building she has lived in for 25 years.
